stem_book: Which of the following is NOT a condition for applying Lami's Theorem? (a) Forces must be non-collinear (b) Forces must be concurrent (c) Forces must be in equilibrium (d) Forces must be perpendicular
work: Lami: three coplanar, concurrent, non-collinear forces in equilibrium, F/sinα equal — no perpendicularity needed ⇒ d
